business also covers distributed energy, power sales, intelligent energy,   源、售電、智慧能源及煤炭等領域。
coal mining, and other areas.

Accounting Policies                                                          會計政策
Property, plant and equipment                                                物業、廠房及設備
The amendments specify that the costs of any item that were produced         該修訂明確規定，在將一項物業、廠房及設備
while bringing an item of property, plant and equipment to the location      達到管理層擬定的營運方式所必要的位置及
and condition necessary for it to be capable of operating in the manner      條件（例如測試相關資產是否正常運行時生產
intended by management (such as samples produced when testing                的樣本）時產生的任何項目銷售的收益應根據
whether the relevant property, plant and equipment is functioning            適 用 的 標 準 確 認 並 計 入 損 益。項 目 的 成 本 則
properly) and the proceeds from selling such items should be recognised      根據香港會計準則第2號存貨之規定計算。
and measured in the profit or loss in accordance with applicable
standards. The cost of the items are measured in accordance with HKAS

Foreign exchange risk                                                       匯率風險
The Group collects substantially all of its revenue in RMB and most of      本 集 團 的 收 入 幾 乎 全 部 以 人 民 幣 收 取，本 集
the Group’s expenses, including expenses incurred in its operations and     團的大部分支出（包括經營產生的支出及資本

                                                                            取。

RMB is not a freely convertible currency. Future exchange rates of RMB      人 民 幣 並 非 自 由 兌 換 貨 幣。未 來 人 民 幣 匯 率
could vary significantly from the current or historical exchange rates as   可能因中國政府實施管制而與現行或過往的

political changes and supply and demand. The appreciation or                元升值或貶值可能對本集團的經營業績造成

have positive or negative impact on the results of operations of the

   4.2 Significant accounting policies                                      4.2 重大會計政策
       Fair value is the price that would be received to sell an asset        公允價值是於計量日期市場參與
       or paid to transfer a liability in an orderly transaction between      者間於有秩序交易中出售資產所
       market participants at the measurement date, regardless of             收取或轉讓負債須支付之價格，而
       whether that price is directly observable or estimated using           不論該價格為可直接觀察取得或
       another valuation technique. In estimating the fair value              可使用其他估值方法估計。於估計
       of an asset or a liability, the Group takes into account the           資產或負債之公允價值時，本集團
       characteristics of the asset or liability if market participants       會考慮該等市場參與者於計量日
       would take those characteristics into account when pricing             期對資產或負債定價時所考慮之
       the asset or liability at the measurement date. Fair value             資產或負債之特點。於該等合併財
       for measurement and/or disclosure purposes in these                    務報表中作計量及╱或披露用途

             Basis of consolidation                                                  合併基準

             The consolidated financial statements incorporate the                   合併財務報表包括本公司及由本

             by the Company and its subsidiaries. Control is achieved                財 務 報 表。倘 本 公 司 達 成 以 下 事
             when the Company:                                                       項，則視為取得控制：

             •      has power over the investee;                                     •   對被投資方擁有權力；

             •      is exposed, or has rights, to variable returns from its          •   就參與被投資方所得可變回
                    involvement with the investee; and                                   報面臨風險或擁有權利；及

                                                                                         報之能力。

       Business combinations                                                   業務合併

       A business is an integrated set of activities and assets which          業務指一整套活動及資產，其中包
       includes an input and a substantive process that together               括一項資源投入及一項實質過程，
       significantly contribute to the ability to create outputs. The          而兩者對創造產出之能力具有 重
       acquired processes are considered substantive if they are               大貢獻。倘收購過程對持續產出之
       critical to the ability to continue producing outputs, including        能 力 至 關 重 要，包 括 對 具 備 執 行
       an organised workforce with the necessary skills, knowledge,            相 關 過 程 所 需 技 能、知 識 或 經 驗
       or experience to perform the related processes or they                  之組織勞動力，或對持續產出之能
       significantly contribute to the ability to continue producing           力有重大貢獻，則被視為獨特或稀
       outputs and are considered unique or scarce or cannot be                缺，或在無重大成本、努力 或持續
       replaced without significant cost, effort, or delay in the ability      產出能力出現延遲之情況下不可
       to continue producing outputs.                                          取代。

       Acquisitions of businesses, other than business combination             收購業務乃採用收購法入賬。於業

       acquiree. Acquisition-related costs are generally recognised in         益中確認。
       profit or loss as incurred.

       the present obligation, its carrying amount is the present value       面值為該等現金流量之現值（倘貨

       money is material).

22. DEFERRED TAXATION (CONTINUED)                                          22. 遞延稅項（續）
   Under the EIT Law of PRC, withholding tax is imposed on dividends         根據中國企業所得稅法，由二 零零八年
   declared in respect of profits earned by subsidiaries in the PRC with     一月一日起，就中國附屬公司 賺取的利
   effect from 1 January 2008 onwards.                                       潤所宣派的股息須繳納預扣稅。

   During the year end 31 December 2022, due to short-term                   截至二零二二年十二月三十一日止年
   fluctuation in the bank loan interest rate, RMB4,000,000,000              度，由 於 銀 行 貸 款 利 率 的 短 期 波 動，中
   dividends was paid by the PRC subsidiary primarily for the purpose        國 附 屬 公 司 支 付 人 民 幣4,000,000,000
   of loan repayment, withholding tax of HK$219,938,000 was                  元 的 股 息，主 要 用 作 償 還 貸 款，年 內 確
   recognised during the year.The directors of the Company consider          認 預 扣 稅219,938,000港 元。本 公 司 董
   that the Group, under normal circumstance, has sufficient funds           事 認 為，在 正 常 情 況 下，本 集 團 於 海 外
   in overseas companies and therefore the earnings retained by              公 司 擁 有 充 裕 資 金，因 此 中 國 附 屬 公
   the subsidiaries in the PRC are expected to be reinvested in the          司保留的盈利預期於可預見未來再投
   foreseeable future. Other than an immaterial amount of distributable      資。除 了 中 國 附 屬 公 司 保 留 的 少 量 可

47. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                                    47. 資本風險管理
      The Group’s objectives in managing capital are to safeguard the            本集團資本管理旨在保障本集團的持續
      Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order to provide         經營能力，以向股東提供回報及向 其他
      returns for shareholders and benefits for other stakeholders and to        利益相關者提供裨益，維持優化的 資本
      maintain an optimal capital structure in order to reduce the cost of       結構，以降低資本成本。
      capital.

      In order to maintain or adjust the capital structure, the Group may        為維持或調整資本結構，本集團或 會調
      adjust the amount of dividends paid to shareholders, return capital        整 派 付 予 股 東 的 股 息 金 額、返 還 資 本
      to shareholders, issue new shares or sell assets to reduce debt.           予股東、發行新股或出售資產以減 少債
                                                                                 務。

      The Group monitors its capital based on gearing ratio. This ratio is       本集團根據資本負債比率監察其資本。
      calculated as net debt divided by total equity. Net debt is calculated     該比率按債務淨額除以總權益計 算。債
      as total borrowings and loans from related parties less cash and           務淨額按借貸總額及來自關連方的貸款
      cash equivalents, and pledged and restricted bank deposits.                減現金及現金等價物與已抵押及受限制
                                                                                 銀行存款計算。
